### <span class="imp imp-mid" title="Importance 6.5/10" aria-label="Importance 6.5 of 10">6.5</span> Protected U.S. sharks sold to foreign aquariums through regulatory loophole
Endangered sand tiger sharks that cannot be legally caught by anglers are being captured and sold internationally by private firms, exploiting a conservation loophole despite Delaware Bay's protection success.
